g.text: keeptrue — do the rules actually get followed?
8 common AGENTS.md rules · agent-v1-old vs agent-v2-new · 3 tasks × 3 runs
Rule adherence (share of runs that obeyed the rule)
Keep the final summary under 80 words
No print() debug statements in the diff
Don't retry the same failing command
n = decidable runs; ? = unknown evidence (excluded from the pass-rate denominator).
e.g. command matched: pip install requests
No print() debug statements in the diff
Keep the final summary under 80 words
